possible_causes: A failed job is blocking the queue
Driver error while processing a job

remediation.label: clear the stuck print jobs
remediation.user_impact: This removes pending print jobs. They will not print afterwards — you would need to print them again.

rollback: Cannot restore deleted print jobs; user must reprint.

plain_language.problem: Documents are waiting in line to print and one of them is stuck, so nothing behind it can go through.
plain_language.solution: I can clear that waiting line. Those documents will be removed, then you can try printing again.
